name: failure-match-false-misses
note: the fail_open classifier fails (its model is stubbed to error); with no on_error set that is match_false, so its rule misses. Its trace entry has no score. The fail_closed classifier scores 0.1 and also misses, so routing falls back to default_model

name: failure-match-true-fires
note: the fail_closed classifier fails and has on_error match_true, so its rule fires as if matched (its trace entry has no score). The fail_open classifier scored 0.1 and missed first

name: empty-map-is-not-a-failure
note: an empty score map is a successful result, not a failure, so on_error does not apply; the fail_closed classifier (match_true) reads code as 0 and misses normally instead of firing, so routing falls back to default_model

name: empty-map-on-first-classifier-continues
note: the first classifier returns an empty map, which is a success with code resolving to 0, so its rule misses; evaluation continues and the second rule matches on 0.9. An empty map neither errors nor halts rule evaluation

name: both-maps-empty-default
note: both classifiers return empty maps; both are successful results (not failures), so code resolves to 0 for each and both rules miss, including the match_true one which does not fire. Routing falls back to default_model
